notes:
Account snapshot: Ironcrest is a mid-size developer-tools company building an internal code search + RAG platform for engineering and support. Heavy emphasis on embeddings + reranking for precise code matches. POC underway against their codebase corpora.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-02-11: Intro call (AE Maya) — high-level use case, want single API for hosted/dedicated/private. CTO said: "must look and feel like internal infra."
- 2026-02-26: Technical deep-dive with Owen (SE) — discussed indexing architecture and commit-driven updates.
- 2026-03-01: POC kickoff — sample dataset ingest (subset), ran embeddings + ANN baseline.

POC / technical constraints & requirements:
- Corpus size: ~48M code/document vectors (initial), growing ~0.2M vectors/day from active repos and docs.
- Reindexing pattern: continuous incremental updates (near-real-time for commits) + weekly partial reindex for refactors; occasional full reindex (monthly) for repo layout changes.
- Query profile: developer queries (short natural language + code snippets), avg top-k retrieval 100, rerank top 50 cross-encoder.
- Latency targets: end-to-end RAG query p95 <= 250ms; preferred p95 <= 150ms for interactive code search. Reranker p95 <= 120ms for top-50.
- Throughput: typical steady QPS 20-40, peak bursts to 250 qps during engineering all-hands / release debugging.
- Cost target: target cost per query (retrieval + rerank) < $0.02 (goal), acceptable up to $0.05 if reliability and latency guaranteed.
- Models: prefer open/code-specialized embedding models (on-prem friendly); evaluating quantized vectors and 1536-d embeddings as baseline. Cross-encoder reranker can be medium size, willing to test distilled variants.
- Storage & index: need efficient ANN (HNSW/IVF/OPQ options), prefer turnkey suggestions from Redwood Optimize for index config given vector count and update rate.

Security & compliance notes:
- SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning required for initial deployment.
- Data residency: must keep EU customer code and indexes in EU region for GDPR/legal.
- Audit logging and KMS integration required before procurement.

Operational asks / questions from engineering:
- How does Redwood handle incremental reindexing without impacting p95? Need strategies: background compaction, write buffers, cold/hot shards.
- Batching/caching knobs: want recommendations for autoscale thresholds based on commit rate and QPS.
- Cost modeling: show per-query cost tradeoff for rerank depth (top-10 vs top-50) and caching prefix reuse for repeated queries.

Meeting quotes / call notes (verbatim-ish):
- CTO: "If we have to sacrifice real-time updates for cost we'll lose dev trust. Reindexing latency is as much a UX metric as retrieval quality."
- Lead Search Eng: "We can tolerate some stale results for non-critical branches but mainline must be sub-5s consistent."

Deliverables / POC scope:
- Ingest 5M vectors (sample) + simulate incremental daily updates; validate p95 latency under mixed workload.
- Run 3 reranker configs (baseline, distilled, quantized) and measure p95 & cost per query.
- Provide index config recommendations and a cost-per-query model for Dedicated vs Private deployments.
